MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "All That Echoes feels like a natural next choice because I enjoyed Stages and want more of Josh Groban's expressive singing and lush arrangements.",
    "Il Divo - The Greatest Hits connects directly with my interest in A Musical Affair and Amor & Pasion; that classical crossover vocal style is what I want more of."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Christmas albums connect with something I have listened to before, but seasonal music does not fit what I want now.",
    "Adele's albums offer expressive vocals, but that alone does not give me the orchestral and classical crossover sound I am seeking.",
    "I cannot judge The Very Best Of from its title alone because I do not know whose music it contains."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My past Christmas listening seems to have been taken as an ongoing preference regardless of occasion.",
    "Enjoying strong singers seems to have been interpreted too broadly; vocal appeal alone does not make every album a close match."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My latest choice of relaxing classical music matters alongside my earlier interest in classical crossover singers.",
    "Familiar voices and lush arrangements matter more to me right now than a broad connection to vocal music; Partners and It's the Girls! appeal, but are lower priorities."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in expressive vocals but gave too much weight to Christmas listening and too little to my current preference for classical and orchestral sounds."
}
